message:
As I was tidying up my little corner of the world, I found myself reflecting on how much I enjoy being prepared. There’s something wonderfully satisfying about having a well-stocked emergency kit. It gives me peace of mind knowing that I have what I need, even if it’s just a few snacks and a flashlight. 

I came across a great resource that outlines everything you might want in your own kit — it’s a helpful guide for anyone looking to feel a bit more secure in their home. After all, being gloriously over-prepared might just be my secret superpower. What little things do you keep on hand, just in case?
